metadata.description: Wire format for `GET /v1/admin/status`: process identity, catalog counts and live telemetry. Source of truth for the writer: `crates/vibe-index/src/server/routes/admin.rs` (`Status`); the generated reader lives in `crates/vibe-wire/src/generated/index_http/e1/admin_status_response/`. The three `u64` telemetry fields are emitted today as JSON numbers; JTD has no 64-bit integer, so their uint32 declarations deliberately preserve loud refusal rather than silently round through float64 (reported as a server/schema deviation in the packet report).
The registry name held by the in-memory index.
The registry source URL held by the in-memory index.
The generator identity copied from the index at server boot.
Whole seconds since server startup. The Rust writer is u64 and emits a JSON number; uint32 is JTD's widest exact unsigned integer and refuses larger values loudly.
Whether mutation routes are disabled for this process.
How many `(group, name)` packages the index holds, including packages whose versions this build quarantines.
How many versions the index holds, including quarantined versions.
Requests observed by this process, including the status request itself. The Rust writer is u64 and emits a JSON number; uint32 preserves exactness and loud refusal within JTD's range.
State-changing mutations completed by this process. The Rust writer is u64 and emits a JSON number; uint32 preserves exactness and loud refusal within JTD's range.
